title: Fail over and restore the strongest working cloud brain during missions
goal: During real multi-step execution, promptly replace the brain when it stops working due to exhausted credit/quota, lockout, service failure or access errors. Preserve mission context, tool receipts, job ownership and bounded budgets without replaying uncertain side effects. Use the strongest remaining eligible working target; independent parallel workers continue. Restore the stronger brain at safe checkpoints after fresh recovery evidence, with hysteresis to prevent oscillation. Report model transitions and reasons truthfully; do not claim intent success from successful selection or probe. Hermetic production-dispatch tests cover midstream and between-step failure, weaker working fallback, recovery and all-cloud-blocked paths. Implement nonzero tests named powerful_cloud_brain_recovery_* exercising production behavior.
